assumptions.bridge_representation: Each network edge or arc is represented by one highway bridge.
assumptions.bridge_class: Pilot assumption: each arc is one ordinary HWB11 bridge.
assumptions.coordinates: Digitised figure coordinates are unitless; no spatial GMPE is applied.
assumptions.functionality: A bridge is unusable when damage reaches Extensive or Complete.
assumptions.dependence: Bridge states are sampled independently conditional on the hazard scenario.
